lines.text: Le-ma-yi ka-ne-gv u-na-dv-ga-nv-gi, da-ni-yv-gv-i, a-le da-na-tlo-yi-hv-i, a-le u-tsa-ti u-ne-lu-gv-i; le-tsi-li da-s-go-ni-hv tsu-we-tsi, a-le nu-du-li-s-gv-na ge-sv u-nu-wo-hi-s-di-yi, nv-di-ga-li-s-do-di-s-gv na-ne-hv-na-quo ge-sv-i.
lines.english: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
lines.emitted_text: lemayi khanekv unathvkanvki av taniyvhka'i ski ale tanatloyhihv'i ale utsathi unelhuhkv'i vi letsili tahskonhihv tsuwetsi v atle nutulihskvna akehsv' i unhawohiyhtiye natakalihstohtihskvki v nanehvnakwu kehsv'i

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏲᎱᏒ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏄᏛᏁᎴ ᏦᏩ ᎠᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬ ᎢᏥᏈᏱ,
lines.text: Hna-quo-no E-lo-dv u-yo-hu-sv, gv-ni-yu-quo di-ka-hna-wa-di-do-hi Yi-ho-wa u-tse-li-ga gv-ni-ge-sv nu-dv-ne-le Tso-wa a-s-gi-da-s-gv I-tsi-qui-yi,
lines.english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏔᎴᎲᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎭᏘᏄᎦ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎮᎾ ᎢᏏᎵᏱ, ᎿᎭᏉᏰᏃ ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎬᏅ ᏧᏂᏲᎲᎩ.
lines.text: Hi-a nu-we-se-le-i; Ta-le-hv-ga a-le ha-ti-nu-ga a-yo-li a-le u-tsi, a-le he-na I-si-li-yi, hna-quo-ye-no du-ni-yo-hu-sv a-yo-li gv-nv tsu-ni-yo-hv-gi.
lines.english: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏚᎴᏅᏃ ᎤᏘᏅᏎ ᎠᏲᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᏏᎵᏱ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ.
lines.text: Du-le-nv-no u-ti-nv-se a-yo-li a-le u-tsi, a-le I-si-li-yi wu-lu-tse-i.
lines.english: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᏥᎳ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏧᏗᏱ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎡᎶᏛ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ, ᎤᏍᎦᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏯᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬᎢ, ᎨᎵᎵ ᏭᎪᎸᏍᏔᏁᎢ;
lines.text: A-se-no u-dv-ga-nv A-tsi-la u-gv-wi-yu-hi ge-sv Tsu-di-yi u-do-da E-lo-dv u-da-ne-tli-yv-s-da-ne-lv-i, u-s-ga-le na-hna wu-lo-hi-s-di-yi; a-se-no U-ne-la-nv-hi u-we-ya-ta-nv-hi ge-sv a-s-gi-da-s-gv-i, Ge-li-li wu-go-lv-s-ta-ne-i;
lines.english: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎦᏚᎲᏃ ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᏧᏙᎢᏛ ᏭᎷᏨ ᎾᎿᎭᎡᎮᎢ.  ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏧᏂᏁᏤᎢ, ᎾᏎᎵᏗ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ, ᏧᎾᏛᏁᎢ.
lines.text: Ga-du-hv-no Na-se-li-di tsu-do-i-dv wu-lu-tsv na-hna e-he-i.  Na-s-gi-no u-do-hi-yu-ne a-na-do-le-ho-s-gi tsu-ni-ne-tse-i, Na-se-li-di e-hi a-go-se-he-s-di, tsu-na-dv-ne-i.
lines.english: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
